description: CJ Affiliate conversion image and S2S reads on www.emjcd.com/u. Click-redirect hosts are not contracted.

params.name: CID
params.description: It is the numeric CJ Enterprise ID. CJ documents it as CID on the `/u` conversion endpoint.
params.fix_hint: Set `CID` to the Enterprise ID from CJ Account Manager.

params.name: TYPE
params.description: It is the Action ID for the conversion. CJ documents a unique TYPE per action.
params.fix_hint: Set `TYPE` to the Action ID from Account Manager.

params.name: OID
params.description: It is the unique order reference. CJ documents it for cross-referencing the transaction.
params.fix_hint: Set `OID` to a unique alphanumeric order ID, with no email address.
